model: Orbital Economy v7.7.10 Labor candidate r1
note: Task 028 fragment. All numeric parameters introduced by the labor declaration are annotated. Every A/B pair introduced here is intentionally symmetric: identical labor intensity where the node creates one and Automation Level = 0 at model start. Smelting and Electronics labor intensities already exist in v7.7.9 and are therefore not new annotations.

Minimum Human Labor Share.effect: Sets the irreducible human share in every generated Automation Factor.

Automation Labor Exponent.effect: Shapes the relation between Automation Level and Automation Factor; value 1 gives a linear response above the human-share floor.

A Mining Labor per Unit.role: Mining labor intensity for colony A, value 0.05.
A Mining Labor per Unit.effect: Multiplies A Mining output and its Automation Factor to form the process Labor Requirement. The A/B pair is intentionally symmetric at 0.05/0.05.

B Mining Labor per Unit.role: Mining labor intensity for colony B, value 0.05.
B Mining Labor per Unit.effect: Multiplies B Mining output and its Automation Factor to form the process Labor Requirement. The A/B pair is intentionally symmetric at 0.05/0.05.
